subject: reasoning
question: A says to B, "I am the daughter of the only son of your father." How is B related to A?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

"Your father" → B’s father.

"The only son of your father" → B’s father’s only son → **B himself**.

"I am the daughter of B" → **A is B’s daughter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/687cf8587d89f8e892428ab7c0e8ec707ca63ddc508eaffe81c7937e220a4a40.png] 

So, B is A’s father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
